title: TEA-Lab/TwoByTwo
abstract:
[CVPR 2025]🌷This is the official repository of "Two by Two✌️ : Learning Multi-Task Pairwise Objects Assembly for Generalizable Robot Manipulation"

# [Two by Two✌️ : Learning Multi-Task Pairwise Objects Assembly for Generalizable Robot Manipulation](https://tea-lab.github.io/TwoByTwo/) Project Page | arXiv | Twitter | Dataset Yu Qi* , Yuanchen Ju* , Tianming Wei , Chi Chu , Lawson L.S. Wong , Huazhe Xu **CVPR, 2025** # 🛠️ Installation This project is tested on Ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 11.8. - Install [Anaconda](https://www.anaconda.com/docs/getting-started/anaconda/install#macos-linux-installation:to-download-a-different-version) or [Miniconda](https://www.anaconda.com/docs/getting-started/miniconda/install#linux-terminal-installer) - Clone the repository and create the environment. The environment should be installed correctly within minutes. - (Optional) If you would like to calculate Chamfer Distance, clone the [CUDA-accelerated Chamfer Distance library](https://github.com/ThibaultGROUEIX/ChamferDistancePytorch/tree/master): ## 🧩 Dataset 2BY2 Dataset has been released. To obtain our dataset, please fill out this [form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfhPcAdky8ZojjPlSSHN4ubYqc7WHIwfiqFW2L5YpqAHbbVgg/viewform?usp=sharing). [News] 🆕Sep-29-2025: We have fixed some mis-match problems in the dataset and update the new mesh in the original link. ## 🍰 Dataset Utility Support It is recommended to use our pre-generated point cloud. In the meantime, you can also generate your own point cloud, add your own data, or generate **URDF(Unified Robot Description Format)** file for robot simulation purpose, please see `data_util` folder for more detailed instructions. ## 🐰Training and Inference In `src/config` modify the path of `log_dir` `data root_dir`. We support Distributed Data Parallel Training. - Train Network B - Train Network A - Inference # 🎟️ Licence This repository is released under the MIT license. abstract_zh: 本文是论文“Two by Two✌️：学习多任务成对物体组装以实现通用机器人操作”的官方仓库。我们提出了一个用于通用机器人操作的多任务成对物体组装方法，并发布了2BY2数据集。该数据集支持点云生成、自定义数据添加以及URDF文件生成，用于机器人仿真。我们提供了训练和推理代码，支持分布式数据并行训练。代码基于SE3-part-assembly开发，并在MIT许可证下发布。
tldr_zh: 提出多任务成对物体组装方法，并发布2BY2数据集，用于通用机器人操作。
cover_zh: 机器人组装新突破｜多任务成对学习，操作更通用

judge.reason: CVPR 2025官方多任务物体组装操作算法，含数据集与代码，具科研价值。
